english.title: Telecommunications operator/employee etc make unauthorised disclosure - Part 3 Investigatory Powers Act 2016
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[a telecommunications operator,]_
(B)_[an employee or person engaged for purposes of the business of a telecommunications operator,]_

without reasonable excuse, disclosed to a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), the existence of:

(C)_[a requirement imposed on you by virtue of Part 3 of the Investigatory Powers Act 2016]_
(D)_[a request made in pursuance of an authorisation for you]_

to disclose communications data relating to that person
english.legislation: Contrary to section 82(1) and (3) of the Investigatory Powers Act 2016.
english.pointstoprove:

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
INDICTMENT: 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.Note:
In relation to an offence committed before paragraph 24(2) of Schedule 22 to the Sentencing Act 2020 comes into force (01/12/20), the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.Time limit for prosecutions:
None
